Render a HowMaHiCo QC report from the installed package templates

Source: R/run-report.R
run_howmahico_report.Rd

Thin wrapper around rmarkdown::render() that locates one of the package's two report templates via system.file() and renders it with the supplied params. One call renders one report — composable (loop it for batch runs, see derive_filtered_annotation()/the batch-rendering example below) and Docker-idiomatic ("one container run = one job").

Usage

run_howmahico_report(
  template = c("00_mhc_report", "00_mhc_upsets", "01_id_counts", "02_overlaps",
    "03_lcms_qc", "04_quant"),
  params,
  output_file,
  ...
)

Arguments

template

Which report template to render. "00_mhc_report" is the all-in-one QC report (it parses the raw search files itself). The remaining templates are focused reports that render against a pep_all cache built once by build_pep_all() (or by 00_mhc_report): "00_mhc_upsets" (per-sample overlap/UpSet), "01_id_counts" (general identification QC: counts, size distributions, motifs, PTM), "02_overlaps" (intra-Condition / cross-Condition / pairwise overlap), "03_lcms_qc" (RT/1k0/mz distributions, Score/ppm QC), and "04_quant" (log2(Area) correlation, Area %CV).

params

Named list of report parameters, as declared in the template's YAML header (SampleSet, AnnotationFile, Subset, FolderData, FolderResults, FolderFigures, Software, MHCclass, ...). The report title is auto-generated from SampleSet, Subset, MHCclass, and the render date — no Title param needed. Key params: MHCclass — "MHC1" (8-13 AA window, default) or "MHC2" (12-25 AA window); overrides ShortPeptideLengthMin/ShortPeptideLengthMax when set to a recognised value. Pass ProjectDir = "/absolute/path/to/project" to resolve relative folder paths from that directory instead of the current working directory — useful when R is started from a subdirectory.

output_file

Output HTML file path. Relative paths are resolved against params$ProjectDir (if supplied) or the current working directory at call time — never against the package-internal skeleton location.

...

Additional arguments forwarded to rmarkdown::render() (e.g. quiet, envir).

Value

The path to the rendered output file (invisibly), as returned by rmarkdown::render().

Details

FolderData/FolderResults/FolderFigures in params are absolute paths (or paths relative to the current working directory at render time) — unlike the legacy 0_code/-era reports, the rendered template no longer assumes a fixed project-root-relative layout, since it now lives inside an installed package and can be rendered from anywhere.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
run_howmahico_report(
  template = "00_mhc_report",
  params = list(SampleSet = "MEGF_035_K251128",
                AnnotationFile = "sample_annotation_dda_all.csv",
                Subset = "dda_all",
                FolderData = "/data/2_data",
                FolderResults = "/data/3_results",
                FolderFigures = "/data/4_figures",
                Software = "fragpipe_dda_combined"),
  output_file = "01_report_main__hla1_dda_all.html"
)

# Focused-report framework: build the pep_all cache once, then render any
# subset of the focused reports against it (no re-parsing per report).
annot <- read_annot("1_documentation/sample_annotation_dda_all.csv")
build_pep_all(software = "fragpipe_dda_combined", folder_data = "2_data",
              annotation = annot, shortpep_range = c(8, 13),
              file_rda = "2_data/dda_all_pep_all.rda")
focused_params <- list(SampleSet = "MEGF_035", Subset = "dda_all",
                       FolderData = "2_data", FolderResults = "3_results",
                       FolderFigures = "4_figures", Software = "fragpipe_dda_combined")
for (tmpl in c("01_id_counts", "02_overlaps", "03_lcms_qc", "04_quant")) {
  run_howmahico_report(tmpl, params = focused_params,
                       output_file = paste0(tmpl, "__dda_all.html"))
}

# Batch-rendering pattern (preserves 00_knit_reports.R's 6-subset loop):
annot_jy <- derive_filtered_annotation("sample_annotation_dda_all.csv",
                                       "1_documentation", "JY")
for (subset in c("dda_all", "dda_jy", "dda_plasma")) {
  run_howmahico_report(template = "00_mhc_report",
                       params = list(Subset = subset, ...),
                       output_file = paste0("01_report_main__hla1_", subset, ".html"))
}
} # }
